intro: The Sleep Grande Mattress is expertly designed to support, soothe, and cool, making every night feel like a retreat. Because you deserve more than just sleep—you deserve deep, restorative rest.

features.title: Adaptive support for perfect posture
features.text: Sleep Grande’s innovative 7-zone pocket springs adapt to your body’s contours, providing tailored support from head to toe for balanced posture and restful sleep.

features.title: The perfect balance of comfort and firmness
features.text: Designed to balance support and comfort, this medium-firm mattress cradles you softly while ensuring proper spine alignment and pressure relief.

features.title: Stay cool and fresh all night
features.text: Stay cool and refreshed with a soft, breathable knitted top cover that enhances airflow and wicks away moisture for a serene, uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Plush comfort that lasts
features.text: The high-quality polyurethane foam ensures an additional layer of plush comfort, wrapping you in softness night after night.

features.title: Durable Upholstery Fabric Side Trim
features.text: The side trims, crafted from premium upholstery fabric, provide enhanced durability and strength. This ensures your mattress remains sturdy and visually appealing over years of use.

features.title: Designed to fit seamlessly into your bed
features.text: Available in standard and customised dimensions, Sleep Grande fits seamlessly into your bedroom, offering hassle-free compatibility with various bed frames.

name: Sleep Grande Single Bed Spring Mattress 78 X 36 X 6 Inches
